description:
Connect Four with 15 levels, 20 boards, match mode and perfect analysis

ConnectFour Studio is a free, offline Connect Four program: play against the computer, analyse positions and run engine-versus-engine matches. It is the Android version of the desktop program of the same name, with the same engine, levels, help and texts.

Engine

  • Perfect play: a Kotlin port of the BitBully solver by Markus Thill (bitboards, MTD(f), transposition table) with the 12-ply opening book with distances – identical results to the original C++ engine
  • 15 levels: 0 Loser (joke level), 1 Random … 14 Perfect, defined by (p, s, w): share of perfect moves, loss guard and win guard
  • Two custom levels User (1) and User (2) with your own (p, s, w)

Analysis

  • Evaluation row under the board: win / draw / loss for every column and the number of stones until the end
  • Permanent analysis after every move, one-off evaluation of all moves
  • Info box with depth, value, nodes, time, speed and source (book or computed)

Game modes

  • Human vs. computer (the computer can also open), two players, computer plays out the position
  • Computer-computer match with up to 10,000 games, colour swap, three speeds, Elo difference and copyable result
  • Session score human vs. computer per level with Elo estimate
  • Random start positions with 1–9 stones and a chosen result

More

  • 20 boards with matching stones, ghost stone, drop animation, last move and winning line marked
  • Load and save positions as .4gp files (compatible with the desktop version), quick save
  • Detailed help with search and zoom, user interface in English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch and Italian
  • Portrait and landscape, phones and tablets, keyboard shortcuts with a hardware keyboard
  • No permissions, no internet access, no ads, no tracking

License: GNU AGPL v3. Engine: BitBully by Markus Thill (AGPL v3), opening book: bitbully-databases (MIT).
